status: initial evidence review; remaining full-text and primary-study follow-ups are explicit
searchScope: Foundational learning/performance, self-explanation, inquiry, feedback; refreshed motivation and mathematics game reviews through 27 September 2026; discipline and accessibility sources
accessNote: Full-text means the document was accessible and relevant methods/results/limitations were inspected, not that every reference was exhaustively read. No effect sizes are promised for LearnLab. Primary-source access category denotes direct source access; historical status is separately described.

decisions.decision: Separate practice success, independent competence, retention and transfer
decisions.strength: Integrative review; converging evidence rather than a product trial
decisions.limitations: Motor/verbal tasks and laboratory research; no direct estimate for LearnLab
decisions.validation: Fresh tasks and delayed checks; preserve non-attainment

decisions.decision: Ask for causal explanation and show an exemplar without claiming objective free-text marking
decisions.strength: Meta-analysis with diverse instructional tasks; supports prompted reasoning
decisions.limitations: Prompt quality and populations vary; pooled result does not certify our rubric or bundle
decisions.validation: Compare explanations using authored criteria; human review for open claims

decisions.decision: Offer purposeful exploration plus authored support, not unguided discovery
decisions.strength: Meta-analysis of guidance comparisons across inquiry studies
decisions.limitations: Limited age-specific evidence; guidance categories and tasks vary; no universal recovery ladder
decisions.validation: Playtest novice/struggling paths and assistance accounting

decisions.decision: Explain the mechanism and useful next action after a mistake
decisions.strength: Broad random-effects meta-analysis, with moderator and limitation discussion inspected
decisions.limitations: High heterogeneity, publication/reporting bias and varying comparators; more information is not a licence for long feedback
decisions.validation: Trace each error to feedback; test whether the next independent task improves

decisions.decision: Provide choice and visible conceptual payoff; measure enjoyment separately
decisions.strength: Systematic review/meta-analysis; methods and discussion inspected
decisions.limitations: Mostly self-report motivation; perceived competence is not independently tested competence; intervention duration and instructors confound interpretation
decisions.validation: Optional continuation/return and fresh performance alongside owner report

decisions.decision: Avoid claiming that game elements guarantee STEM learning
decisions.strength: 2026 systematic review/meta-analysis; methods, sensitivity and discussion inspected
decisions.limitations: Motivation outcome; engagement measures limited; many quasi-experiments; sensitivity excluding lower-quality studies is imprecise and includes no effect
decisions.validation: Retain neutral and negative observations; separate learning and enjoyment

decisions.decision: Refresh game-based learning evidence without assuming a universal advantage
decisions.strength: Recent second-order meta-analysis identified; publisher full text unavailable to this browsing session
decisions.limitations: Only indexed abstract/summary accessible; no detailed methodological claims or effect sizes taken from it
decisions.validation: Obtain full text before relying on detailed findings; no release claim based on this lead

decisions.decision: Use retrieval, spacing and worked examples as contextual tools
decisions.strength: Commissioned evidence-review landing summary; full report not yet assessed
decisions.limitations: Lab-to-classroom and subject transfer uncertain; no claim that every skill recipe is replicated
decisions.validation: Inspect full report and relevant fading/retention studies before locking broader course policies

decisions.decision: Build from sensible voltage/current/resistance reasoning and counterexample tests
decisions.strength: 2024 primary multi-university conceptual-response research; methods and implications inspected
decisions.limitations: University samples; context-sensitive ideas, not fixed learner labels or a causal trial of this app
decisions.validation: Feedback addresses current-used-up/fixed-current reasoning; fresh layouts test transfer

decisions.decision: Bound pilot to ideal DC resistors, conservation, measurement and power
decisions.strength: Live official specification checked against existing electricity-dc objectives
decisions.limitations: Introduction is not complete exam preparation; internal resistance, resistivity and non-ohmic devices outside initial model
decisions.validation: Outcome map, unit checks and unsupported-configuration diagnostics

decisions.decision: Use series sums, parallel conductance sums and P=VI in a bounded ideal model
decisions.strength: Established theory checked in textbook sections and AQA
decisions.limitations: No unrestricted electronics solver; ideal wires/source/resistors; no transients or heating-dependent resistance
decisions.validation: Independent hand calculations, conservation invariants and open/fault boundary tests

decisions.decision: Distinguish observed events, inferred mechanisms and uncertain origin
decisions.strength: Museum historical synthesis and myth discussion accessed
decisions.limitations: Museum interpretation is secondary historical evidence; it is an authoritative factual reference, not an eyewitness; illustrations copyrighted
decisions.validation: Use own labelled schematic/map; compare actual primary accounts; no invented quotations

decisions.decision: Investigate provenance, context and corroboration before forming a claim
decisions.strength: Provider curriculum guidance and linked evaluation overview inspected
decisions.limitations: Practice guidance/evaluation summary; original evaluation paper not yet read; classroom support differs from solo learners
decisions.validation: Authored evidence rubric and human evaluation of defensible interpretations

decisions.decision: Provide tap/click and keyboard alternatives to dragging
decisions.strength: W3C WCAG 2.2 understanding documents
decisions.limitations: Standards compliance is not established by screenshots; actual reader/device experience may differ
decisions.validation: Drive real interactions, focus, text alternatives, reduced motion and text expansion

decisions.decision: Make repairing and evidence discovery the payoff; allow multiple investigation orders
decisions.strength: Developer talk abstract inspected; slides located, not fully reviewed
decisions.limitations: Game-design account, not causal learning evidence; no claim that game success transfers to a course
decisions.validation: Owner finds controls/question clear, can explore, wants to continue; revise from observations

decisions.decision: Use visual language to expose concepts with concise labels
decisions.strength: Developer talk abstract inspected; video not watched
decisions.limitations: Design reference only; no copied assets/layout and no learning claim
decisions.validation: Playtest schematic and table representations in both themes and small layouts

decisions.decision: Offer hints, representation, worked example, prerequisite, retry and escape
decisions.strength: Owner contract plus guided-inquiry/feedback evidence motivates support
decisions.limitations: Exact ladder and idle cutoff are hypotheses; inactivity alone does not show difficulty
decisions.validation: Record help; assisted paths never give independent credit; owner revision

decisions.decision: Let learners vary current and observation time, then check charge passing a point using Q = It for steady flow
decisions.strength: Direct textbook definition checked against the official AQA electricity specification
decisions.limitations: The counter integrates a steady ideal current; it does not simulate transients or moving individual charges. Matching a displayed number is practice, not transfer evidence.
decisions.validation: Hand-check 1 A over 4 s and 2 A over 2 s; test both reachable configurations and fresh choice calculations

decisions.decision: Expose source voltage as energy per coulomb and integrated energy as P times observation time
decisions.strength: Direct textbook derivation of P = IV checked against AQA current/potential-difference scope
decisions.limitations: Only ideal ohmic constant-parameter loads; no thermal feedback or realistic lamp claim. Source and load energies are magnitudes here.
decisions.validation: Hand-check 6 V, 6 ohms, 4 s gives 1 A, 4 C, 24 J; test fresh E/Q and fixed-voltage reasoning

decisions.decision: Make learners redistribute two series resistances, inspect shared current and voltage drops, then predict a new path
decisions.strength: Established series rules and conservation checked against textbook and current AQA specification
decisions.limitations: Ideal constant-voltage source, ohmic loads and negligible wires; equal-current rule does not imply equal voltage drops. Tasks are authored applications, not measured human learning.
decisions.validation: Hand-derive current, both voltage drops and power for every control setting; inspect rendered series diagram and fresh transfer answer

decisions.decision: Have learners open a backup branch, preserve an intact main route and sum branch currents at a junction
decisions.strength: Established parallel voltage/current relations and charge conservation checked in textbook and specification
decisions.limitations: The main-branch independence claim assumes an ideal fixed-voltage source; real supplies may sag or have internal resistance. Branches are bounded series/parallel trees.
decisions.validation: Hand-derive open/closed branch readings, junction sum and alternate resistor settings; test browser switch, recovery and transfer

decisions.decision: Let learners compare rival ideal-DC fault predictions by placing an ammeter or voltmeter; require a reading that separates the hypotheses, and follow practice with fresh pre-reveal decisions.
decisions.strength: Current AQA specification confirms ideal meter assumption, DC series/parallel relationships and practical measurement and design skills; it does not evaluate this learning interaction.
decisions.limitations: An ideal model omits meter loading, uncertainty, physical lead placement and practical safety. Selecting a diagnostic probe after trying others is practice, not independent mastery.
decisions.validation: Hand-calculate every candidate and meter position, reject identical displayed predictions as diagnostic, test wrong-probe and fresh-choice paths, browser focus/touch/offline and owner observation.

decisions.decision: Let learners find two voltage/current configurations with the same power, then allocate a two-branch source budget and distinguish W from J.
decisions.strength: Established P = VI, E = Pt and ideal ohmic circuit relationships checked against the previously reviewed textbook section and current AQA electricity scope; not a trial of this activity.
decisions.limitations: Fixed ideal voltage, steady ohmic resistance and an observation window; no battery depletion, temperature-dependent resistance or real lamp model. Equal power can occur at different current and voltage, but this task does not prove transfer in humans.
decisions.validation: Derive both 12 W configurations and the 12 W + 6 W, 10 s = 180 J budget; check all reachable controls, W/J/C distractors and fresh browser decisions.

decisions.decision: Present an open backup link and a higher-resistance complete backup as competing causes, then check a measured repair against predicted branch current and power.
decisions.strength: Current specification covers conservation, series/parallel relationships, ideal meters and electrical measurement; the hypothesis-choice interaction is an authored design hypothesis.
decisions.limitations: No real meter uncertainty, loading, physical lead placement or multiple simultaneous hidden faults. Candidate comparison is guided practice; fresh choices and later capstone are needed for broader diagnosis evidence.
decisions.validation: Derive open/closed current and switch voltage, reject nondiagnostic main readings, verify the repair reaches 2 A and 12 W backup, play poor-probe and assisted paths in browsers.
